title.narrative: Education Sector Support Project in Nicaragua (PROSEN)

description.narrative:
UNOPS has signed an agreement with the Delegation of the European Union in Nicaragua for assistance in the implementation of education projects, financed by the European Union. The assistance includes the diagnosis of the situation, in terms of infrastructure, of the schools prioritized by the Ministry of Education, the design, construction/remodeling and equipment of the same and the supervision of the infrastructure works. Additionally, the projects will implement components related to teacher training, curricular updating, and institutional strengthening.

The Project for the Implementation of the Second Program to Support the Strategy of the Education Sector in Nicaragua (PROSEN II) have the objective of supporting the implementation of the new Education Plan of Nicaragua (PdE) 2017-2021, whose main objective is to raise the quality of education at all educational levels at the national level, and its strategies to improve the quality of secondary education, thus improving learning outcomes and skills for the employability of the most vulnerable population, with emphasis on rural areas.
